title: Command-line interface for Ledgerly
pr_description: Adds a ledgerly CLI with register, login, add, list and summary commands so the service can be used without writing Python. Token is cached in the user's home directory between invocations.

defects.description: Amount conversion goes through float: int(float('19.99')*100) == 1998, silently losing a cent. The repo already has utils.parse_money for exactly this; the CLI must use it.
main() catches every exception, prints the message and falls through to return 0, so scripted callers see success on failure. Errors must set a non-zero exit code.
register/login take the password as a positional command-line argument, exposing it in shell history and the process list (ps). It should be read via getpass or stdin.

The token file is created with default umask permissions and only chmod'ed to 0600 afterwards, leaving a window where other local users can read the session token. Create it with restrictive permissions atomically (os.open with 0o600). Added during label adjudication.
